The value of 12284 corresponds to 5 contributions to EURF 2.15 814 954 8048 2326 105 In all of them the EURF indicator was encoded as a logframe indicator and there arent comments in OPSYS to clarify to what it corresponds to the justification of the match and any calculations involved. From the narrative of the report is also unclear to know if there is double counting amongst the individuals reported under the different values. It is therefore decided to only report the highest value of all of them 8048 which corresponds to the number of youth registered and successfully completed skill development courses.
